lines.text: Many learners say: Always I drink coffee in the morning.
Better: I always drink coffee in the morning.
The first! I always drink coffee.

data.wrong: Always I drink coffee in the morning.
data.right: I always drink coffee in the morning.

native.tip: Em português dá para dizer “Sempre tomo café”; em inglês, “always” vem depois de “I” e antes do verbo: “I always drink.”
native.caption: Você também diz isso? “Always I drink coffee in the morning.” 😅 O certo é “I always drink coffee in the morning.” Em português dá para dizer “Sempre tomo café de manhã”; em inglês, “always” vem depois de “I” e antes do verbo: “I always drink.” Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “I always drink coffee.” Agora escreva uma frase sua com “I always drink” e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: In Portuguese you can say “Sempre tomo café”; in English, “always” comes after “I” and before the verb: “I always drink.”
en.caption: Do you say this too? “Always I drink coffee in the morning.” 😅 The right way is “I always drink coffee in the morning.” In Portuguese you can say “Sempre tomo café de manhã”; in English, “always” comes after “I” and before the verb: “I always drink.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
